contentCn:
你的身体上长有很多毛发。纤细的汗毛长在了你身体的大部分位置，粗粗的毛发会从你的头上长出来。不过，你的手掌和脚底不会长毛发。

每根毛发都从皮肤里的一个小囊袋里长出来。这个小囊袋的名字叫毛囊，每个毛囊的底部都有血液供应，血液让毛发生长。毛发周围通常会有分泌油脂的结构，油脂让毛发更具光泽。
contentEn:
There is lots of hair on your body. Fine, thin hair called vellus hair covers most of your body. Thicker hair grows on your head. But there is no hair on your palms or the soles of your feet.

Each hair grows out of a tiny pouch in your skin called a follicle. At the bottom of every follicle, blood brings food and oxygen to help the hair grow. Glands near the hair make oil that keeps your hair shiny and soft.
